_comment: Historical hosted-skip baseline for .github/workflows/test.yml, from the last Actions run that reached Tier 2 (Sylveste-psey). Criterion 4 defines the allowed skip set by IDENTITY, not by a count: a test file that grows raises the count without reducing coverage, which is why the earlier 274 cap was unmeetable.
verified_by: review-fable 2026-09-20 from the full run log
opus-5 2026-09-20 independent re-count from the same log

tests/shell/test_b3_calibration.bats.why: setup() skips every case in the file when the interspect sibling checkout is absent, and test.yml checks out only mistakeknot/interstat. The file held 37 cases at 0ac49e82 and 55 at HEAD, so its skip count rises without any coverage being lost.
